summary: Explains interactive step mode with `--step`, where Ansible asks before each task: y to run, n to skip, c to continue all remaining tasks without asking.
questions: How do I run a playbook one task at a time and confirm each?
What do y/n/c mean in step mode?
How do I get out of step mode and just run the rest?

answer_card.title: Step mode
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible-playbook playbook.yml --step
```
Ansible stops before each task and asks, e.g.:
```shell
Perform task: configure ssh (y/n/c):
```
- `y`: run the task
- `n`: skip it
- `c`: exit step mode and run all remaining tasks without asking
